mediums.medium: Accessible solarpunk green-synth pop at 112 BPM in D mixolydian, dry alto lead over glassy polysynth, muted electric bass, hand percussion, and receipt-click transients; 5/7/4 verse cells feed a late-landing six-line hook, then the printer tick phase-locks to wrist pulse in a wide but vocal-forward mix.

Accessible public-utility synthpop at 110 BPM in B minor with warm mono synth, clipped mallets, rubbery bass, and idling low drone; short verse/pre-hook/long-hook architecture leaves the decisive public-principle line completely dry while clattering invoice sounds dissolve into communal handclaps.

Accessible bio-ambient pulse-pop at 100 BPM in A major with suspended add-nine harmony, close neutral lead, airy countervoice, felt percussion, and localized speaker-cone tremolo; six unequal micro-stanzas alternate with two-line prayers before a nearly whispered sensory-question hook.

Accessible future-nostalgic electronica at 98 BPM in E lydian with rounded sub pulse, server-fan harmonics, bowed glass, granular choir, and warm close vocal; stanza lengths grow 2/3/4/5/6/7 while a muted final prayer makes disconnection audible without using silence.

Accessible crystalline art pop at 94 BPM in F-sharp dorian, intimate alto over plucked synth, prepared dulcimer, soft kick, and breath percussion; a rondo returns after 9/5/3-line verses while task-language and layers disappear, and punch-clock clicks evolve into a human breathing polyrhythm.

Accessible bio-adaptive folk-electronic at 90 BPM in C major with dry low mezzo, nylon-string harmonics, woody percussion, and responsive synth bloom; the unfinished-list refrain returns in progressively lighter arrangements until heel-pressure rhythm redistributes the ensemble's downbeat.

Ambitious industrial grief and glitch-core at 140 BPM in C-sharp minor with unstable half-time, hard-consonant close vocal, crushed metal percussion, encrypted sibilant swarm, and sub-pressure; through-composed registers exchange vertical authority once, with controlled near-clipping only at the consent overclaim.

Ambitious neuro-cross privacy-noise at 138 BPM in G phrygian with tense spoken-sung lead, granular consonants, dry tom attacks, bowed cymbal, and descending sub; no repeated chorus, only changing hard-consonant anaphora as the audit-log layer loses semantic alignment.

Ambitious microtonal bio-industrial chamber at 110 BPM around B with 5/4 percussion grid, free-time contralto witness, contrabass harmonics, two identical kicks with unequal sub-decay, and sparse metal resonance; paired magnitude appears once at the hinge before the grid splits by depth.

Ambitious seismic bass chamber at 108 BPM around E-flat with detuned low reeds, modular sub, skin drum, and dry gender-ambiguous vocal; a repeated word changes stress across enjambed cells while microtonal pressure makes threshold equivalence physically unstable.

Ambitious microtonal green-synth chamber at 104 BPM alternating 7/8 and 4/4, two contrasting close voices, glass harmonics, soft modular pulse, and beating vocal processors; call-and-response categories fail sequentially and one-phoneme near-rhymes preserve relational distance.

Ambitious glitch-baroque devotional pop at 102 BPM in an unresolved just-intonation field, intimate duet over plucked strings, muted digital harpsichord, and near-unison harmonizers; the paired voices approach convergence, stop one partial short, and leave the final category unanswered.
